answer: Reaching the ember of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Work waits on the inlet until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the willow of the next round.
